snaps.formation: Set (about 3.0 to 4.5 s): Mundt inline L with Smith off the ball just outside him; Goedert wing R off the RT's hip, Wicks on the line in a reduced slot R about 2 yards outside the right hash. Barkley deep behind Hurts. Smith then runs across to the right, turns around outside Wicks and comes back, so he is behind Mundt on the left again as the ball is snapped.
snaps.motion: Smith / tight L off the ball / across behind the QB to outside Wicks R, turns (about 1 s pause near 10 s) and returns across to L / at snap (moving, behind Mundt)
snaps.notes: Supplied setT 13.0 is mid-motion (Smith already crossing back). Pulled alt frames 3.0-14.0. Smith #6 is still on the LEFT at 3.0 and 4.5 with the line down and Hurts under center, so I charted that as the set (2x2, strength Rt by Goedert tiebreak). The earlier chart's 3x1 Rt (Smith slot R) is the look at about 9.5-10.5 s when Smith is briefly outside Wicks on the right: he turns around there with at most a 1 s pause, and I could not confirm a full reset, hence formation M. If that pause counts as a shift-and-set, the chart's 3x1 'T' Rt is the right call. #6, #83, #88, #26, #1 read; Wicks by elimination (only other WR in 12 personnel, same neon gloves as #13 on W1-002). Hash: ball on the near (bottom) NFL hash on sideline = offense left; end zone agrees. The field also carries wider college hash marks.

snaps.formation: Set (2.0 to 4.0 s): Mundt and Goedert both off the ball as wings outside the RT, Mundt off the RT's hip and Goedert about one line split outside him; Wicks on the line about two line splits outside Goedert (reduced slot R); Smith alone L on the line just inside the numbers. Barkley deep. Goedert then walks out to outside Wicks, pauses, and comes back in toward the formation at the snap.
snaps.motion: Goedert / wing R outside Mundt / out to outside Wicks R, brief pause, then back in toward the formation / at snap (moving in)
snaps.notes: Supplied setT 6.0 shows Goedert outside Wicks, off the ball: that is the chart's 'Goedert split wide R'. Alt frames 0.5-3.5 show he started attached next to Mundt (double tight right) and walked out at about 4.5, so the first set is the tighter look. Either way it is 3x1 Rt. Even at 6.0 Goedert is only a yard or two outside the right college hash, not wide. Goedert on or off the ball at 3.5 is not clear (looks level with Mundt): charted as wing/off. Wicks looks on the line on both angles, which would cover Mundt: unsure. #83, #88 (4.5 s frame), #13, #26 read; Smith by elimination (number not read). REVIEW (alt/A): changed Mundt from inline/on the line to wing/off the ball. On the 3.0 s sideline frame (zoomed) both tight ends sit about a yard deeper than the RT, level with each other, and Wicks is up on the line. Smith's feet are level with the LT's on the left, so he is on the line too; with Mundt also on, that would be 8 on the line, so Mundt has to be off. This matches the owner's drawing (two wings, Z on the line). Family left as 3x1 'T': on the 3.0 s end zone frame Wicks is about two line splits outside Goedert, so the three are not close enough to touch. The owner drew this spacing as Bunch; whether it counts as Bunch is his call.

snaps.formation: Set (1.0 to 4.0 s): Goedert wing L off the LT's hip, two receivers in the slot L (inside one on the line just outside the left hash, outside one off the ball about 1.5 yards wider); one receiver alone R on the outer edge of the numbers. Hurts in gun, Barkley beside him to the right. Goedert then crosses behind the line to wing R and is there as the ball is snapped (2x2 as snapped).
snaps.motion: Goedert / wing L / across behind the line, in front of the QB, to wing R / at snap (arrives about 6.5 s, snap about 6.8 s)
snaps.notes: Disagree with the earlier chart (2x2 Rt, no motion). Both angles at 1.0, 2.5 and 4.0 s show #88 on the LEFT wing with two receivers left: trips left. Supplied setT 5.0 is mid-motion (end zone shows #88 running behind the LT). The chart recorded where he ended up; it had no end zone clip. He reaches wing R at about 6.5 and the ball is snapped right after: I could not see a full one-second reset, so I treat it as motion and chart the starting set. If it is ruled a shift, the chart's 2x2 Rt stands. Trips left is compressed but not close enough to touch: not Bunch. Hash: ball on the far (top) NFL hash on sideline = offense right; end zone has the center just inside the right hash. Receiver numbers not readable.

snaps.formation: Set (3.0 to 4.5 s): Mundt inline L with Smith off the ball just outside him; Goedert wing R off the RT's hip, Cooper on the line tight outside Goedert. Barkley deep. Smith runs across to outside Cooper on the right, turns around and comes back, and is behind Mundt on the left again at the snap.
snaps.motion: Smith / tight L off the ball / across behind the QB to outside Cooper R, turns (about 9.0-10.0 s) and returns across to L / at snap (moving, behind Mundt)
snaps.notes: Same picture as W1-001. Supplied setT 12.0 is mid-motion (Smith behind the QB heading left). Smith #6 is still on the LEFT at 3.0 and 4.5 with the offense down, so the first set is 2x2. The chart's 3x1 Rt (Cooper outside Goedert, Smith outside Cooper) is the look at about 9 s, when Smith is turning around on the right without a clear reset. If that turn counts as a set, 3x1 'T' Rt is right. Cooper is #80 (read on end zone). #83, #88, #6, #26 read. Hash: ball on the near NFL hash on sideline, center on the left hash on end zone.

snaps.formation: Goedert inline R (hand down), one receiver in a reduced slot R just outside the right college hash; Lemon tight L off the ball about 2 yards outside the LT, one receiver L on the line at the inside edge of the numbers. Hurts in gun, Bigsby beside him to the right. No motion.
snaps.notes: Back is #8 with BIGSBY on the nameplate (end zone): that confirms Bigsby's number. #9 Lemon and #88 read on end zone. The slot R receiver has the same neon gloves as #13 Wicks but the number is not readable: left null, as is the outside L receiver. Slot R looks about 1.5 yards off the ball on sideline. Strength by Goedert tiebreak. Hash: near NFL hash on sideline, left hash on end zone.

snaps.formation: After the shift: Goedert inline R (two-point), one receiver R just inside the numbers; two receivers L, one in the slot just inside the numbers and one wide outside the numbers. Hurts in gun, Shipley beside him to the right. Before the shift it was 3x1 Rt with two receivers paired at the numbers R.
snaps.motion: WR (not identified) / paired with the outside receiver at the numbers R / behind the line across to slot L / stop-and-set (moves about 6-9 s, set from 10.5, snap about 14.5)
snaps.notes: Agrees with the earlier chart. 4.5 s frame shows the 3x1 Rt start, 7.5 the receiver crossing, 10.5-13.5 everyone still. Back is #28 Shipley (read on end zone), #88 read. No receiver number readable. On or off the ball for the receivers is a best read from sideline: slot L and the R receiver look off, wide L on.

snaps.formation: Mundt inline R, Goedert wing R off Mundt's outside hip, Wicks on the line in a reduced slot R on the right college hash; Smith alone L on the numbers. Barkley deep. Goedert goes in motion across the backfield to the left at the snap.
snaps.motion: Goedert / wing R outside Mundt / across the backfield behind the QB to L / at snap
snaps.notes: Supplied setT 4.5 already has Goedert moving (end zone shows him running between Mundt and Wicks), so charted from 3.7 where everyone is still (same at 0.5, 2.0, 3.0). Only difference from the chart notes: Wicks is not wide, he is on the college hash about 4 yards outside the tight ends. #83, #13, #26 read on end zone; Goedert by elimination (second TE, number partly visible); Smith by elimination (number not read).

snaps.formation: No attached tight end. R: Goedert split wide outside the numbers (off the ball), Wicks in the slot on the line. L: two receivers stacked just inside the numbers, one on the line and Lemon about 2 yards behind him, a shade outside. Hurts in gun, Barkley beside him to the right. Lemon goes in motion toward the backfield at the snap.
snaps.motion: Lemon / back man of the stack L, just inside the numbers / in behind the QB across toward R / at snap
snaps.notes: Supplied setT 4.5 has Lemon already turning to start the motion: charted from 3.8 (same at 1.5 and 3.0). Two differences from the earlier chart. (1) It could not find Goedert: the man split wide right has a tight end build and his number reads 88 at 4x zoom on sideline (not crisp), so strength = Rt by Y tiebreak (chart had none). (2) The left pair is a stack, not a slot and a wideout: Lemon #9 is behind the front receiver and less than a yard outside him. It is a staggered stack, so if you want a true one-behind-the-other for 'S', call it 2x2 'D'. #13, #9, #26 read; front L receiver not readable. The end zone angle crops the stack, so the stack read is sideline only. I did not track where Lemon is at the snap beyond the 5.3 s frame (heading in toward the QB).

snaps.formation: Goedert inline R (two-point), Wicks on the line just inside the numbers R, Lemon off the ball at Wicks' outside hip on the inside edge of the numbers; Smith alone L, about halfway between the left hash and the numbers (wide side of the field). Hurts in gun, Barkley beside him to the right. Lemon goes in motion inside at the snap.
snaps.motion: Lemon / outside Wicks R, off the ball / in behind Goedert and across the formation between the line and the QB toward L / at snap
snaps.notes: Supplied setT 4.5 has Lemon leaning into his motion; 2.5 and 3.5 are the clean set. Agrees with the earlier chart. Formation M because Wicks and Lemon are a close pair (about a yard apart, Lemon a yard back): I read it as side by side, not a stack, but it is near enough that someone could call it one. Smith is charted slot by landmark even though he is the only receiver on that side. Wicks looks on the line on end zone, which would cover Goedert: unsure. #13, #9, #88, #26 read on end zone; Smith by elimination (number not read). Hash: center on the right hash on end zone.

snaps.formation: After the shift: Goedert wing R off the RT's hip, one receiver R on the outer edge of the numbers; two receivers in the slot L (inside one on the line near the left college hash, outside one off the ball a couple of yards wider). Hurts in gun, Barkley beside him to the LEFT. Before the shift Goedert was attached on the left (3x1 Lt).
snaps.motion: Goedert / attached L next to the LT / across behind the line to wing R / stop-and-set (moves about 6-8 s, set from 9.0, snap about 14.5)
snaps.notes: Agrees with the earlier chart. 4.5 s frame shows Goedert left, 7.5 crossing, 9.0 through 13.5 set on the right. #88, #26 read on end zone. Receiver numbers not readable. Hash: center on the right hash on end zone, ball on the far NFL hash on sideline.

snaps.formation: Goedert inline L (hand down), Smith L off the ball at the inside edge of the numbers; Mundt inline R, Wicks on the line tight outside Mundt. Barkley deep. Smith goes in motion across the formation behind the line at the snap.
snaps.motion: Smith / L at the numbers, off the ball / in and across behind the line toward R / at snap (behind the right side as the ball is snapped)
snaps.notes: Supplied setT 6.0 has Smith already running behind the LG: charted from 4.5 (same at 1.5 and 3.0). Agrees with the earlier chart. Strength Lt by Goedert tiebreak. #88, #83, #13, #26 read on end zone, #6 read on sideline. Wicks looks on the line, which would cover Mundt: unsure. Hash: center on the left hash on end zone, ball on the near NFL hash on sideline.

snaps.formation: Under center, Barkley deep behind Hurts. Left: Jenkins attached next to the LT, Mundt outside him a half step off the ball. Right: Goedert attached next to the RT (a half step off), Wicks alone wide right outside the numbers, on the line. No motion.
snaps.notes: End zone (camera behind offense): 83 - 84 - 68 - 69 - C - 56 - 65 - 88 read left to right, 26 deep. Sideline (top = offense right): lone receiver at the top outside the numbers. Wicks named by elimination: 13 personnel leaves one wideout and the play text has the pass to Wicks deep right. Strength: two eligibles each side (Jenkins + Mundt left, Goedert + Wicks right), so balanced and it goes to Goedert's side = Rt. Earlier chart said Lt, which is the two-tight-end side. If strength should follow the heavier tight end surface, it is Lt. On/off the ball for Mundt and Goedert is a half-step read on both angles: M.

snaps.formation: Under center, Barkley deep. Left: Mundt attached next to the LT (a half step off), Wicks tight outside him on the line. Right: Goedert inline, Smith off the ball on the right numbers. As snapped: Smith is running in behind the line and is behind the QB area at about 6.3 s.
snaps.motion: D.Smith / numbers R, off the ball / in flat behind the line toward the QB / at snap
snaps.notes: Charted from 3.5 s (alt/W1-013-t3.5-*): the 5.0 s set frame already has Smith moving. End zone: 83, 88, 6 and 26 read. Sideline: 13 read tight left. Motion disagreement with the earlier chart: it has Wicks motioning from wide L in to the LT at the snap. I see Wicks walking in to the tight left spot at 0.5 s and standing still from 2.0 s on (a shift, stop-and-set), and the man moving at the snap is #6 Smith from the right (alt/W1-013-mont.jpg, frames 5.7 and 6.3). Hash: ball just inside the right hash column on the end zone angle, goal-line area, so M.

snaps.formation: Gun, Barkley offset left of Hurts. Right: Goedert attached next to the RT in a two-point stance (a half step off), Lemon about 3 yards outside him on the line, Wicks a yard outside and a yard behind Lemon. Left: Smith alone on the left numbers, on the line. No motion.
snaps.notes: End zone (behind offense): 26, 1, 88, 9, 13 read. Sideline zoom: 6 read on the single receiver left (alt/W1-014-zoom-sl-x.jpg). Lemon and Wicks are a tight pair but Goedert is about 3 yards inside them, so not a bunch, and Wicks is offset outside Lemon rather than directly behind, so not a stack. Ball on the left hash column on the end zone angle.

snaps.formation: Gun, Barkley offset left of Hurts. Left: Goedert attached next to the LT in a two-point stance (a half step off), Wicks wide outside the left numbers on the line. Right: Lemon in the slot off the ball, Smith on the right numbers on the line. No motion.
snaps.notes: Disagree with the earlier chart (3x1 Str Rt). End zone here faces the offense (Hurts' chest number visible), so screen right = offense left: 88 is the end man on screen right next to 68 and 69, three bodies on that side of the center (alt/W1-015-zoom-ez.jpg). Sideline (Q2, top = offense left): 88 at the top end of the line next to 68 (alt/W1-015-zoom-line.jpg), 13 wide at the top, slot and 6 at the bottom (alt/W1-015-zoom-wr.jpg). Both angles put Goedert left, which makes it two and two, and the Y tiebreak makes strength Lt. Slot receiver: long hair and a number that looks like 9, same look as the clean #9 reads on W1-016 and W1-018, so Lemon, M on that name.

snaps.formation: Gun, Barkley offset right of Hurts. Right: Goedert flexed about 3 yards off the RT, standing, on the line. Smith on the right numbers, off the ball. Left: Lemon in the slot off the ball, Wicks wide outside the left numbers on the line. No motion.
snaps.notes: Numbers read on zooms (alt/W1-016-zoom.jpg): 13 wide left, 9 slot left, 6 right numbers, 88 flexed right on both angles. End zone faces the offense: Goedert on screen left = offense right, 26 on the same side of Hurts. Balanced, strength to Goedert. On/off the ball for Smith is a close call (about a yard behind Goedert's depth): M on that one detail.

snaps.formation: Under center, Barkley deep. Set (9 to 11 s): Goedert inline right, Wicks off the ball on the right numbers. Left: Lemon standing 2 to 3 yards outside the LT on the left hash, off the ball, and a third receiver in the slot outside him on the line. As snapped: Wicks has come in to a wing spot behind Goedert's inside hip.
snaps.motion: D.Wicks / numbers R, off the ball / in to a wing behind Goedert / at snap. Before that Lemon shifted from outside in to the tight left spot (stop-and-set by about 9 s)
snaps.notes: Charted from 11.0 s (alt/W1-017-t11.0-*), the 14.5 s set frame is mid-motion. Disagree with the earlier chart on family (2 Back) and on the motion. Only Barkley is ever in the backfield with Hurts on either angle from 6 s to the snap. Line read on the end zone zoom (alt/W1-017-zoom-ez11.jpg): 88 - 65 - 56 - 51 - 69 - 68, then #9 standing outside 68. Wicks (13 read at 11 s on the sideline) starts on the right numbers, jogs in at 12.5 s, is outside Goedert at 13.5 s and behind him at 14.5 s, snap about 15.5 s (alt/W1-017-montB.jpg). Nobody passes behind the QB. Outer left receiver: number not readable (side on), not in the end zone frame. Probably Smith (same three wideouts on the next two snaps) but left null. Hash from the end zone angle (ball on the screen-left column, camera facing the offense = offense right), the sideline rows are hard to separate, so M.

snaps.formation: Gun, Barkley offset left of Hurts. Right: Goedert inline next to the RT, Wicks tight outside him, about 3 yards, off the ball. Left: Lemon about 3 yards outside the LT off the ball, a third receiver on the left numbers on the line. No motion.
snaps.notes: Zooms (alt/W1-018-zoom.jpg): 88 next to 65 on the end zone angle, attached and not flexed as the earlier chart note has it. 9 read on the inner left receiver, 13 on the right receiver, 26 in the backfield. Outer left receiver unread (single digit, white cleats, probably Smith), left null. Wicks is not in the end zone frame, so his depth is sideline only and on/off the ball there is not certain: that is the M.

snaps.formation: Gun, Barkley offset left of Hurts. Left: Goedert alone, standing just outside the LT on the line. Right: three receivers in a bunch about 3 yards outside the RT. Wicks is the point on the line, Lemon inside and behind him, the third receiver outside and behind him. No motion.
snaps.notes: Same three right, one left as the earlier chart, but the three are an arm's length apart in a triangle on the sideline zoom (alt/W1-019-zoom.jpg, zoom2), which is a bunch by the definition, and Bunch outranks 3x1. If the earlier pass meant a tight trips, that is the only difference. They hold still from 10.5 s to 14.3 s. 9 read on both angles, 13 on the sideline, 88 and 26 on the end zone. Outer bunch receiver: single digit that looks like a 6, white cleats, probably Smith, left null. Only Lemon of the bunch is inside the end zone frame.

snaps.formation: Under center, Barkley deep. Set (1 to 4 s): Mundt inline right with a hand down, Wicks tight outside him off the ball. Left: Lemon in a close slot about 4 yards off the LT, off the ball, a third receiver outside him just inside the left numbers on the line. As snapped: Wicks has crossed behind the QB to the left and is next to the two left receivers, three left and Mundt alone right.
snaps.motion: D.Wicks / tight R, off the ball / across the formation behind the QB to the left, out to the two receivers / at snap
snaps.notes: Charted from 2.5 s (alt/W1-020-t2.5-*), the 6.0 s set frame is mid-motion. The tight end is #83 Mundt, not Goedert: 83 read twice on the end zone angle next to 65 (alt/W1-020-zoom.jpg). Strength goes to the only tight end = Rt. 9 and 26 read on the end zone, 13 on the sideline. Outer left receiver unread, left null. Motion: the earlier chart has a receiver from wide R coming in toward the formation. I see Wicks start tight right, turn at 5 s, pass behind the RT at 6 s, behind the LT at 7 s and reach the left receivers at 7.7 s with the ball still not snapped (alt/W1-020-montB.jpg, alt/W1-020-m7.7.jpg). I did not catch the exact snap frame, so he may have settled for a beat before the snap.

snaps.formation: Gun, Barkley offset right of Hurts. No tight end attached: five linemen only. Left: three in a bunch out on the left numbers, one point man on the line and two behind him, inside and outside. Right: one receiver alone on the right numbers. No motion.
snaps.notes: The end zone clip exists for this snap (the earlier chart had it missing). It shows five linemen, Hurts and the back only, back on screen left with the camera facing the offense = offense right, ball on the right hash column. The sideline shows the three left a yard or two apart in a triangle (alt/W1-021-zoom-L.jpg), unchanged from 0.5 s to 5.0 s, so Bunch rather than plain 3x1. None of the four jersey numbers out wide could be read (bunch is outside the end zone frame, side on to the sideline camera), so the tight end and the three wideouts are not told apart: all four null, and which bunch man is the TE is unknown. pos on those rows is a placeholder that keeps the 1 TE / 3 WR count. Barkley from the play text. The right receiver's depth is a close call: on_line true is M.

snaps.formation: Gun, Barkley offset left of Hurts. Left: Goedert inline with a hand down, alone. Right: three receivers spread: Lemon about 3 yards outside the RT off the ball, Wicks in the slot off the ball, a third receiver on the right numbers on the line. No motion.
snaps.notes: The end zone clip exists for this snap too. 88 read there at the left end of the line behind defender 98 (camera facing the offense, screen right = offense left), ball on the left hash column. Receivers are outside the end zone frame. Sideline zoom (alt/W1-022-zoom.jpg): inner man has Lemon's long hair and a partial 9, middle man a two-digit number starting with 1 and dark cleats = Wicks, both M on the name. Outer man single digit, white cleats, probably Smith, left null. Barkley from the play text.

snaps.formation: Under center, single back deep. Double tight left: Mundt next to the left tackle, Goedert outside him, both on the ball. Wicks off the ball a few yards outside Goedert. Smith alone right, on the line at the inside edge of the numbers. Snapped as set.
snaps.notes: End zone (camera faces the offense, so screen right = offense left): read 83 and 88 on the left end of the line, 83 inside, both at line depth. Sideline: read 13 off the ball left and 6 on the line right. Two wide receivers are detached, so not Big. Back wears a single digit that looks like 8: named Bigsby from the play text, number not confirmed. Ball on the offense-right NFL hash on both angles (the field also has wider college hash ticks: ignore those).

snaps.formation: Gun, back offset to the quarterback's left. Both tight ends right: Goedert on the line split about two yards from the right tackle, Mundt off the ball in the gap between the tackle and Goedert. Two receivers left, close together at the numbers: Smith on the line, Wicks just outside him and off the ball. Snapped as set.
snaps.notes: End zone: read 88 widest right on the line and 83 a step off the ball inside him. Sideline: read 13 and 6 on the left at the painted 10. Wicks is behind and outside Smith, not directly behind, so not a stack. Balanced 2x2: strength to Goedert's side. Ball is between the hashes, a bit toward the offense's right (end zone angle only, so M). Back: single digit, same look as the back on W1-023, not readable here so left null.

snaps.formation: Gun, Shipley offset to the quarterback's right. Goedert inline left. Two receivers left at the numbers: Wicks on the line, Lemon off the ball just behind and outside him. One receiver right in the slot, off the ball. As snapped: Lemon is running across behind the quarterback toward the right.
snaps.motion: Lemon / off the ball outside Wicks at the numbers L / across the formation behind the QB to R / at snap
snaps.notes: The supplied set frame (13.5) is mid-motion, so charted from 11.0 where all eleven are still. End zone: 88 inline on the offense's left, 28 to the right of the quarterback. Sideline: read 13 on the line left, read 9 on the motion man as he passed the tackle (12.5). Right receiver is a single digit (6 or 0), not readable: null. Lemon is close behind Wicks (near stack), but it is 3x1 either way. Ball on the left NFL hash on both angles.

snaps.formation: Gun, Shipley offset to the quarterback's left. Goedert right, standing, a short split off the right tackle and a touch off the ball. Smith in the right slot on the line. Two receivers left, close together just inside the numbers: the inside man on the line, Wicks outside him off the ball. Snapped as set.
snaps.notes: End zone: read 88 right, 28 left of the quarterback, and 6 at the frame edge outside Goedert. Sideline: read 13 on the outside left man. Inside left receiver has long hair and white cleats like the #9 read on W1-025 (same no-huddle drive), probably Lemon, but the number is not readable: null. On/off the ball for Goedert and the left pair is judged from depth against the tackles and is the weak part (M). Balanced: strength to Goedert. Ball on the right NFL hash on both angles.

snaps.formation: Gun, Shipley offset to the quarterback's right. Goedert right, standing, on the line about two yards off the right tackle. One receiver right on the numbers, off the ball. Left: one receiver at the outer edge of the numbers on the line, one in the slot off the ball. Snapped as set.
snaps.notes: End zone: read 88 right and 28 right of the quarterback. No receiver number is readable on either angle, so all three are null. Likely the same three as W1-026 (no huddle): wide left has dark cleats like Wicks, left slot has long hair like Lemon, right has a single digit like Smith. Balanced: strength to Goedert. Ball on the right NFL hash on both angles.

snaps.formation: Gun, Shipley offset to the quarterback's right. Three-man bunch tight to the right tackle: Mundt off the ball about a yard and a half outside the tackle, Wicks on the line just outside him (the point), Lemon off the ball outside and behind Wicks. Smith alone left on the line just inside the numbers. As snapped: Lemon has come back inside behind Mundt toward the box.
snaps.motion: Lemon / outside man of the bunch R / in behind Mundt toward the box / at snap
snaps.notes: The supplied set frame (6.0) is mid-motion, so charted from 4.5 where everyone is still. Sideline: read 83, 13 and 9 in the cluster. End zone: 83 right, 28 right of the quarterback. Earlier chart says 3x1: I see the three right-side men within a yard or two of each other (point man on, two off), which is a bunch by the definition, and Bunch outranks 3x1. If the spacing is judged too loose for a bunch it is 3x1 Rt, hence M. Left receiver's number is not readable: named Smith because 13 and 9 are read on the right, he is the only receiver left in 11 personnel, and the play text has Smith as the deep-left target. Ball on the right NFL hash on both angles.

snaps.formation: Gun, Shipley offset to the quarterback's left. Goedert inline right. Three-receiver bunch left, between the hash and the numbers: one receiver on the line at the point, Smith off the ball inside him, Wicks off the ball outside him. As snapped: Smith is running across behind the line toward the right.
snaps.motion: Smith / inside man of the bunch L / across behind the line to R / at snap
snaps.notes: The supplied set frame (10.5) is mid-motion, so charted from 8.0 (same picture at 6.0). Earlier chart says 3x1 and that Mundt is the tight end: the end zone frame reads 88 (Goedert) inline right, and the three left receivers are close enough to touch, so Bunch (outranks 3x1). M because bunch vs tight trips is a spacing judgment. Read 6 on the motion man (10.5 sideline) and 13 on the outside man. Point man has long hair and white cleats, probably Lemon (the #9 read on W1-028), but the number is not readable: null. Ball on the right NFL hash on both angles.

snaps.formation: Under center, Barkley deep. Goedert inline left, Mundt inline right. Wicks left on the line just inside the numbers. One receiver right on the numbers, off the ball. Snapped as set.
snaps.notes: End zone: read 88 left end, 83 right end, 26 deep. Sideline: left receiver shows a two-digit number starting with 1 and dark cleats: Wicks. Right receiver is a single digit (6 or 0), white cleats, probably Smith (he and Wicks are the 12-personnel pair read on W1-033), but not readable: null. Balanced: strength to Goedert. Ball on the right NFL hash on both angles.

snaps.formation: Gun, Barkley offset to the quarterback's left. No tight end attached. Left: the tight end split wide just outside the numbers, off the ball; Wicks in the slot just inside the numbers, on the line.
